text:
Aisha L.: Hey team, quick question from site visit yesterday. I used a 7-day regional rail pass (company didn't have an agent buying it) and paid for 1-day parking at the airport (EUR 18). Also I had to grab dinner late so missing time for the evening.
Aisha L.: Questions: 1) Are prepaid multi-day rail passes ok if bought on personal card? 2) Parking reimbursable? 3) How do we handle per-diem for arrival day when work started after 8pm?
travel-bot: Reminder: attach purchase receipt(s), proof of travel (itinerary or boarding pass) and manager approval if not booked via travel team. Max file size 10MB.
People Ops (Raj): TL;DR: yes, but need manager pre-approval for > 3-day passes bought personally OR if cost > $300. Parking is reimbursable with receipt. Per-diem: use same-day rules (see below).
Finance Team: Process: submit each item separately in the portal. For rail pass add a note with dates covered and attach screenshot of the pass showing serial or confirmation. For parking add merchant and lot name.
Finance Team: Portal example (copy/paste):
```
expense_type: rail_pass
amount: 92.50
currency: EUR
merchant: RegionalRail Co
date: 2026-02-11
payment_method: personal_card
attachments: rail_pass_pdf, itinerary.png
note: 7-day regional pass used for site visit 2026-02-11 to 2026-02-17; manager preapproval attached.
```
Finance Team: And for parking:
```
expense_type: parking
amount: 18.00
currency: EUR
merchant: ABC Airport Parking
date: 2026-02-11
payment_method: personal_card
attachments: parking_receipt.jpg
note: same-day airport short-stay parking for site visit.
```
People Ops (Raj): Per-diem breakdown: - Overnight in destination = full per-diem. - Same-day travel: >=6 hours away = 50% meal allowance. - If work started after 20:00 local and you stayed overnight, that's still an overnight = full per-diem. - If you returned same day and were away <6 hours, no per-diem.
Aisha L.: Got it. Manager Noah approved the rail pass after the fact (sent email). Is "after the fact" ok?
Manager (Noah): Confirmed I approved retroactively due to short notice. Marked in email thread.
Finance Team: Retro approvals are accepted but flag expenses as "retro_approval" in the note so we can fast-track. If pass was used for personal travel partly, please prorate by days used for company business. Attach usage log or calendar showing business days.
Comms-Bot: FYI: travel_guidelines v2 published last week: link to doc updated with multi-day pass guidance.
Aisha L.: Thanks all 44d I'll submit now with receipts and the manager email.
